scripts.build: npm --prefix web install --no-audit --no-fund && npm --prefix web run build
scripts.dev: npm run build:web && npm run dev -w worker
scripts.test: npm test -w worker && npm --prefix web test
scripts.deploy: wrangler deploy && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote
scripts.deploy:sendm8: npm run build && wrangler deploy --domain sendm8.com && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote

DB.description: Stores forms, submissions and accounts. Created automatically; migrations run on deploy.

BETTER_AUTH_SECRET.description: Signs sessions. Any long random string.

IP_HASH_SECRET.description: Hashes submitter IPs, which are never stored raw. Any long random string.

ENCRYPTION_KEY.description: Exactly 32 random bytes, **base64**. Encrypts stored API keys and webhook URLs. Keep a copy: losing it makes them unreadable.

APP_URL.description: Your site URL, e.g. `https://forms.example.com`. Leave blank to use the first URL the Worker is visited on.

EMAIL_FROM.description: Sender for notification emails, e.g. `Forms <notify@example.com>`. The domain must be verified in [Resend](https://resend.com/domains).

RESEND_API_KEY.description: [Resend](https://resend.com/api-keys) API key for notification emails. Leave blank to only log emails.

GITHUB_CLIENT_SECRET.description: Secret for the GitHub OAuth app.

ADMIN_EMAILS.description: Optional. Comma-separated verified emails that can use `/app/admin`.

TURNSTILE_SITE_KEY.description: Optional [Turnstile](https://dash.cloudflare.com/?to=/:account/turnstile) site key for the spam challenge page.

ALERT_WEBHOOK_URL.description: Optional Discord or Slack webhook for admin alerts: usage, errors, abuse flags, sign-ups and new forms.
